All Roads to Peace#000.dst: Habla con el capitán Goruca en [-{~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#001.src: Hm. It's been long enough, we should've heard back from the diplomacy squad by now...
All Roads to Peace#001.dst: Mmm. Ya ha pasado bastante; el escuadrón diplomático ya debería haber dado noticias...
All Roads to Peace#001.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#002.src: Ah, hello there, Wynn soldier. You should stick around! We were just launching a counterattack against the orc citadel.
All Roads to Peace#002.dst: Ah, hola, soldado de Wynn. ¡Deberías quedarte! Justo lanzábamos un contraataque contra la ciudadela orca.
All Roads to Peace#002.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#003.src: Since you've helped with curbing the orcs elsewhere, you can join in the festivities- Oh, that's them coming over the hills!
All Roads to Peace#003.dst: Ya que nos has ayudado a frenar a los orcos en otros sitios, puedes unirte a la fiesta- ¡Oh, ahí vienen por las colinas!
All Roads to Peace#003.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#004.src: ...A CATAPULT! Since when did the orcs have knowhow to make a CATAPULT?!
All Roads to Peace#004.dst: ...¡UNA CATAPULTA! ¿¡Desde cuándo saben los orcos hacer CATAPULTAS!?
All Roads to Peace#004.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#005.src: I don't know, but they just decimated our golems with it. How are we supposed to deal with that chieftain without our protection?
All Roads to Peace#005.dst: No lo sé, pero acaban de destrozar a nuestros gólems con ella. ¿Cómo vamos a enfrentarnos a ese cacique sin protección?
All Roads to Peace#005.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#006.src: Let's just get to the medical tent and go from there. The captain will need to hear about this.
All Roads to Peace#006.dst: Vayamos a la tienda médica y ya veremos. El capitán tiene que enterarse de esto.
All Roads to Peace#006.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#007.src: Nonono, you don't understand- a CATAPULT?! Seriously, I cannot get over this! Orc catapult! What's the world coming to?!
All Roads to Peace#007.dst: No, no, no, no lo entiendes- ¡¿una CATAPULTA?! ¡En serio, no me lo puedo creer! ¡Una catapulta orca! ¿¡Adónde va a ir a parar el mundo!?
All Roads to Peace#007.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#008.src: ...why do you always have to embarrass me in front of the humans, you idiots...
All Roads to Peace#008.dst: ...¿por qué siempre me dejáis en ridículo ante los humanos, idiotas...?
All Roads to Peace#008.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#009.src: Obviously, it seems we need some backup, soldier. Would you mind coming along to the medical tent with me?
All Roads to Peace#009.dst: Está claro que necesitamos refuerzos, soldado. ¿Te importaría acompañarme a la tienda médica?
All Roads to Peace#009.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#010.src: Follow the captain to the medical tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#010.dst: Sigue al capitán hasta la tienda médica en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#011.src: You lot are useless, you are! We had you sent off with thirty golems! THIRTY! And you come back with nothing to show? Do you have any idea how much that cost us?!
All Roads to Peace#011.dst: ¡Sois unos inútiles, eso es lo que sois! ¡Os mandamos con treinta gólems! ¡TREINTA! ¿Y volvéis sin nada? ¿Tenéis idea de lo que nos costó eso?
All Roads to Peace#011.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#012.src: ORC CATAPULT! I'm telling you, Captain! They crushed our golems with huge honking boulders! What are we supposed to do against that?!
All Roads to Peace#012.dst: ¡CATAPULTA ORCA! ¡Se lo digo en serio, capitán! ¡Aplastaron a los gólems con pedruscos enormes! ¿Qué íbamos a hacer contra eso?
All Roads to Peace#012.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#013.src: He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat, we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
All Roads to Peace#013.dst: Tiene razón, capitán. Tras aplastar a los gólems, los orcos salieron en masa de la fortaleza. Si no llegamos a retirarnos, nos habrían matado a los cuatro.
All Roads to Peace#013.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#014.src: ...fine. I suppose you have a point. And that means it's a good thing we have a human here to pick up all your slack.
All Roads to Peace#014.dst: ...vale. Supongo que tienes razón. Y menos mal que hay un humano aquí para suplir vuestras carencias.
All Roads to Peace#014.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#015.src: Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you've helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
All Roads to Peace#015.dst: ¡Humano! Te pongo al día. Desde que nos ayudaste a recuperar el puesto avanzado del norte, los orcos se han vuelto mucho más agresivos.
All Roads to Peace#015.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#016.src: There have been many attacks here at town, and we've been struggling to fend them off. Thanks to the incompetence of our troops, we haven't been able to-
All Roads to Peace#016.dst: Ha habido muchos ataques aquí en el pueblo y nos cuesta repelerlos. Gracias a la incompetencia de nuestras tropas, no hemos podido-
All Roads to Peace#016.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#017.src: ORC CATAPULT!! ORC CATAPULT!! Listen to the words I am telling you! ORC! CATAPULT!
All Roads to Peace#017.dst: ¡¡CATAPULTA ORCA!! ¡¡CATAPULTA ORCA!! ¡Escuche lo que le estoy diciendo! ¡CATAPULTA! ¡ORCA!
All Roads to Peace#017.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#018.src: ...we haven't been able to get the orc chieftain to listen to reason and sign a new ceasefire yet. If this keeps up, we'll be overwhelmed. The brutes only seem to listen to force...
All Roads to Peace#018.dst: ...aún no hemos logrado que el cacique orco entre en razón y firme un nuevo alto el fuego. Si esto sigue así, nos arrollarán. Esos brutos solo parecen entender la fuerza...
All Roads to Peace#018.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#019.src: And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe, if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
All Roads to Peace#019.dst: Y ahí entras tú, soldado. Necesitamos que vayas a la fortaleza orca y rompas sus defensas. Si les demostramos que igualamos su fuerza, quizá escuchen, ¿no?
All Roads to Peace#019.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#020.src: The fortress is off to the northeast, it's visible from town. Don't come back without a ceasefire- Or the chieftain's head, if peace is out of the question!
All Roads to Peace#020.dst: La fortaleza está al noreste, se ve desde el pueblo. No vuelvas sin un alto el fuego- ¡O sin la cabeza del cacique, si la paz es imposible!
All Roads to Peace#020.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#021.dst: Entra en la Fortaleza Orca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#022.src: Hmh! Human! Just like say, Serepe. Villager fail, then send human to kill.
All Roads to Peace#022.dst: ¡Jmh! ¡Humano! Como decir, Serepe. Aldeano fallar, mandar humano a matar.
All Roads to Peace#022.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#023.src: Idiot big-noses! Human strong, but only one. Need more to break Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#023.dst: ¡Narizotas idiotas! Humano fuerte, pero uno. ¡Hacer falta más contra Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#023.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#024.src: One against four... Human not even beat one. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#024.dst: Uno contra cuatro... Humano ni vencer a uno. ¡Ismikku! ¡Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#024.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#026.src: Idiot. Idiot human. Will die in open. Come.
All Roads to Peace#026.dst: Idiota. Humano idiota. Morir a la intemperie. Ven.

All Roads to Peace#027.src: RRRGHH! Armor heavy! How human carry much weight, but so weak without?!
All Roads to Peace#027.dst: ¡RRRGH! ¡Armadura pesa! ¿¡Cómo humano cargar tanto y tan débil sin ella!?

All Roads to Peace#028.src: Need medicine for...urgh. Blood... Where yarrow root...
All Roads to Peace#028.dst: Necesitar medicina para... urgh. Sangre... ¿Dónde raíz de milenrama...?

All Roads to Peace#029.src: Hmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
All Roads to Peace#029.dst: Jmh. Levanta. ¡Humano! ¡Levanta! ¡Ver humano respirar, estar despierto!

All Roads to Peace#030.src: Name Zuett. Your name, Idiot. But only because taught wrong. So will help idiot. Take medicine.
All Roads to Peace#030.dst: Nombre Zuett. Tu nombre, Idiota. Pero solo porque enseñar mal. Así que ayudar a idiota. Toma medicina.

All Roads to Peace#031.src: Hmh! Better than silly magic potion. Earth heals best...
All Roads to Peace#031.dst: ¡Jmh! Mejor que tonta poción mágica. Tierra curar mejor...
All Roads to Peace#031.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#032.src: Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because orcs kill for "peace"?
All Roads to Peace#032.dst: En fin. ¿Por qué estar aquí? ¿Por qué ahora? Dar buena razón. ¿Porque orcos matar por "paz"?
All Roads to Peace#032.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#033.src: Hmh. Mhm, mhm. Yes, idiot villagers come by, lots of metal villager too. Say want peace- just want kill. Evil war machines.
All Roads to Peace#033.dst: Jmh. Ajá. Sí, aldeanos idiotas venir, y aldeanos de metal. Decir querer paz- solo querer matar. Máquinas de guerra.
All Roads to Peace#033.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#034.src: Human really want peace? Then listen to Zuett. Killing not the way. Orcs strong, but not killers. Villager say, but villager wrong.
All Roads to Peace#034.dst: ¿Humano querer paz de verdad? Entonces escuchar a Zuett. Matar no ser camino. Orcos fuertes, pero no asesinos. Aldeano decir, pero aldeano equivocado.
All Roads to Peace#034.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#035.src: We... Orcs... Not listen to just force. Orcs see strength, not idiot-killing. Human been idiot-killing. Time to stop.
All Roads to Peace#035.dst: Nosotros... Orcos... No escuchar solo fuerza. Ver fuerza, no matanza idiota. Humano hacer matanza. Hora de parar.
All Roads to Peace#035.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#036.src: Whole war stupid. War killing us. Not all Orcs meant to fight. Human need learn first.
All Roads to Peace#036.dst: Toda guerra estúpida. Guerra matarnos. No todo orco nacer para luchar. Humano deber aprender primero.
All Roads to Peace#036.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#037.src: Need talk with Arrai-Veretel. But first, need trust. To start trust, listen to Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#037.dst: Necesitar hablar con Arrai-Veretel. Pero antes, necesitar confianza. Para empezar confianza, escuchar a Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#037.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#038.src: Will give guards peace offer. [Elite Boar Meat]. Go hunt. Look bushes up north.
All Roads to Peace#038.dst: Dar a guardias ofrenda de paz. [Elite Boar Meat]. Ir a cazar. Buscar arbustos al norte.
All Roads to Peace#038.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#039.src: If want walk away like coward, do now. If human trust me...meet by fort after get meat.
All Roads to Peace#039.dst: Si querer irse como cobarde, hacer ahora. Si humano confiar en mí... ver en fuerte tras conseguir carne.
All Roads to Peace#039.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#040.src: Travel to the hunting grounds at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#040.dst: Ve al coto de caza en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#041.src: Speak to Zuett with the Elite Boar Meat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#041.dst: Habla con Zuett con la Elite Boar Meat en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#042.src: Hmh. Hunt like child, but succeed anyway. Human should rely less on magic. Human serious, though.
All Roads to Peace#042.dst: Jmh. Cazar como niño, pero lograr igual. Humano deber usar menos magia. Pero humano ir en serio.
All Roads to Peace#042.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#043.src: Good. Human really want peace. Help stop stupid war... Even though human and villager start anyway...
All Roads to Peace#043.dst: Bien. Humano querer paz de verdad. Ayudar a parar guerra estúpida... Aunque humano y aldeano empezar igual...
All Roads to Peace#043.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#044.src: Follow. We go Centerworld. Guards still angry, but can say good for you. Stay quiet- Zuett do talk.
All Roads to Peace#044.dst: Seguir. Ir a Centerworld. Guardias aún enfadados, pero poder hablar bien de ti. Callar- Zuett hablar.
All Roads to Peace#044.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#045.src: Zuett! What you do? Thought drag away human to kill for good! Why bringing back now?
All Roads to Peace#045.dst: ¡Zuett! ¿Qué hacer? ¡Creer que llevar humano para matar del todo! ¿Por qué traer de vuelta?
All Roads to Peace#045.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#046.src: Zuett bleeding heart. Strong in compassion. Saw hurt, thought help. Stupid, but can respect.
All Roads to Peace#046.dst: Zuett corazón blando. Fuerte en compasión. Ver herido, pensar ayudar. Estúpido, pero poder respetar.
All Roads to Peace#046.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#047.src: Listen to Zuett! Human want peace. Came for peace, but was taught peace come from idiot-killing by villager.
All Roads to Peace#047.dst: ¡Escuchar a Zuett! Humano querer paz. Venir por paz, pero aldeano enseñar que paz venir de matanza idiota.
All Roads to Peace#047.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#048.src: Grrrh! All human say! What special about this human?
All Roads to Peace#048.dst: ¡Grrrh! ¡Todo humano decir! ¿Qué tener de especial este humano?
All Roads to Peace#048.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#049.src: Human listen to Zuett. Hunt spineback boar, bring meat. See? If human not care, human not listen. Not hunt.
All Roads to Peace#049.dst: Humano escuchar a Zuett. Cazar jabalí lomoespín, traer carne. ¿Ver? Si humano no importar, no escuchar. No cazar.
All Roads to Peace#049.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#050.src: ...hm ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
All Roads to Peace#050.dst: ...mmm ... ... ...poder respetar fuerza de humano. Cazar lomoespín, significar fuerte.
All Roads to Peace#050.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#051.src: But strong not mean trust! Strength of body only one thing.
All Roads to Peace#051.dst: ¡Pero fuerte no significar confianza! Fuerza de cuerpo solo una cosa.
All Roads to Peace#051.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#052.src: RESSINTER HURT! RESSINTER HURT BAD! NEED HELP!! HELP NOW!!

All Roads to Peace#053.src: Onluk! Tell what happen! Ressinter...healer hurt?
All Roads to Peace#053.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#054.src: {u}!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
All Roads to Peace#054.dst: ¡¡{u}!! ¡Ressinter único sanador! Zuett querer ser sanador, Creinu querer ser sanador, ¡pero no!
All Roads to Peace#054.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#055.src: KREIMU! Get Kreimu! Mudspring camp! She good healer!
All Roads to Peace#055.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#056.src: Will go! Fast runner! Ressinter no die today! Serepe, deal with human!
All Roads to Peace#056.dst: ¡Ir yo! ¡Correr rápido! ¡Ressinter no morir hoy! ¡Serepe, ocuparse de humano!
All Roads to Peace#056.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#057.src: Hm...HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
All Roads to Peace#057.dst: Mmm... ¡¡MMM!! Humano, eh, ¡humano buen sanador! ¡Curar propia herida con medicina! ¡Humano ayudar!
All Roads to Peace#057.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#058.src: Gwuh?! Zuett! Lying bad! Human idiot no hea-
All Roads to Peace#058.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#059.src: RESSINTER DYING! NO CARE IF LIE! ANY HEALER BETTER THAN NO HEALER!
All Roads to Peace#059.dst: ¡RESSINTER MORIR! ¡DAR IGUAL MENTIRA! ¡SANADOR MEJOR QUE NINGUNO!
All Roads to Peace#059.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#060.src: HEY! ONLUK IDIOT! NO LET HUMAN IN!
All Roads to Peace#060.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#062.src: Follow Onluk to the Medicine Tent through the fortress
All Roads to Peace#062.dst: Sigue a Onluk por la fortaleza hasta la Tienda de Medicinas

All Roads to Peace#063.src: Cannon backfire! Caught in blast! Cut up all over, bleeding bad! Healer already brought medicine tent!
All Roads to Peace#063.dst: ¡Cañón explotar! ¡Pillar en explosión! ¡Cortes por todo, mucha sangre! ¡Sanador ya en tienda de medicinas!
All Roads to Peace#063.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#064.src: Hhhgh. Bad injury... Human. Heal Ressinter, fast!
All Roads to Peace#064.dst: Jjjgh. Herida grave... Humano. ¡Curar a Ressinter, rápido!
All Roads to Peace#064.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#065.src: Make balm to keep healer alive! Even if only keep alive for Kreimu to heal, keep Ressinter alive!
All Roads to Peace#065.dst: ¡Hacer bálsamo para mantener vivo a sanador! ¡Aunque solo aguantar hasta que Kreimu curar, mantener vivo a Ressinter!
All Roads to Peace#065.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#066.src: Mix herbs. Use medicine book. And stay in tent!
All Roads to Peace#066.dst: Mezclar hierbas. Usar libro de medicina. ¡Y quedarse en tienda!
All Roads to Peace#066.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#067.src: Save the injured orc, or keep it alive until rescue arrives
All Roads to Peace#067.dst: Salva al orco herido o mantenlo con vida hasta que llegue ayuda

All Roads to Peace#069.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#069.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#070.src: Here in time. Ressinter still alive...why other balm on cuts?
All Roads to Peace#070.dst: Llegar a tiempo. Ressinter aún vivo... ¿por qué otro bálsamo en cortes?
All Roads to Peace#070.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#071.src: Wait, why human here? Ressinter hurt because human?
All Roads to Peace#071.dst: Espera, ¿por qué humano aquí? ¿Ressinter herido por humano?
All Roads to Peace#071.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#073.src: Human try heal Ressinter. Thought better healer than Zuett. Try hard to keep Ressinter alive.
All Roads to Peace#073.dst: Humano intentar curar a Ressinter. Creer mejor sanador que Zuett. Esforzarse mucho por mantenerlo vivo.
All Roads to Peace#073.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#074.src: ... ... ...Nunexetor. You sensible. Is true? Human try heal Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#074.dst: ... ... ...Nunexetor. Tú sensato. ¿Verdad? ¿Humano intentar curar a Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#074.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#075.src: Yes. The human made herb balms and tried to heal Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#075.dst: Sí. El humano preparó bálsamos de hierbas e intentó curar a Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#075.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#076.src: So Zuett not lie. Human care about orc?
All Roads to Peace#076.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#077.src: See? Human try. Maybe not heal Ressinter full, but try save life of someone call enemy by idiot Villager.
All Roads to Peace#077.dst: ¿Ver? Humano intentar. Quizá no curar del todo, pero intentar salvar vida de quien aldeano idiota llamar enemigo.
All Roads to Peace#077.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#078.src: Human learn Villagers lie. Trying learn about us. War only because Villagers trick! Not because human bad!
All Roads to Peace#078.dst: Humano aprender que aldeanos mentir. Intentar conocernos. ¡Guerra solo por engaño aldeano! ¡No por humano malo!
All Roads to Peace#078.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#079.src: ...hmh! Can respect. Strong in mind if able to learn.
All Roads to Peace#079.dst: ...¡jmh! Poder respetar. Mente fuerte si capaz de aprender.
All Roads to Peace#079.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#080.dst: ¡Estar de acuerdo con Bitteliso y Zuett!
All Roads to Peace#080.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#081.src: Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
All Roads to Peace#081.dst: De acuerdo. Aunque deberíamos volver a nuestras tareas.
All Roads to Peace#081.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#082.src: Will stay for while in case Ressinter need medicine more.
All Roads to Peace#082.dst: Quedarse un rato por si Ressinter necesitar más medicina.
All Roads to Peace#082.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#083.src: Sorry to put human up to task sudden, but now more orc trust you.
All Roads to Peace#083.dst: Perdón por dar tarea de golpe a humano, pero ahora más orcos confiar en ti.
All Roads to Peace#083.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#084.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#084.dst: Ya que orcos confiar... quizá poder hablar con Arrai-Veretel ahora. Seguir.
All Roads to Peace#084.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#086.src: No! Lomoster okay! Ressinter not okay- Wait. Ressinter sort of okay! Need rest still!
All Roads to Peace#086.dst: ¡No! ¡Lomoster bien! Ressinter no bien- Espera. ¡Ressinter más o menos bien! ¡Aún necesitar descanso!
All Roads to Peace#086.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#087.src: But Lomoster at cannon when explode!
All Roads to Peace#087.dst: ¡Pero Lomoster junto a cañón al explotar!
All Roads to Peace#087.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#088.src: Lomoster wear armor. Armor took hurt, Lomoster okay!
All Roads to Peace#088.dst: Lomoster llevar armadura. Armadura recibir daño, ¡Lomoster bien!
All Roads to Peace#088.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#090.src: Human heal Ressinter. See? Human good healer!
All Roads to Peace#090.dst: Humano curar a Ressinter. ¿Ver? ¡Humano buen sanador!
All Roads to Peace#090.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#091.src: I don't believe it. How did-
All Roads to Peace#091.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#093.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting, I- Whuh...
All Roads to Peace#093.dst: ¡Gwuh, sí! Dejar de gritar, yo- Uah...
All Roads to Peace#093.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#095.src: Wait, Ressinter okay? How did- HUMAN?! WHY HUMAN IN CAMP?!
All Roads to Peace#095.dst: ¿Ressinter bien? Cómo- ¿¡HUMANO!? ¿¡POR QUÉ HUMANO EN CAMPAMENTO!?
All Roads to Peace#095.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#096.src: Human heal Ressinter! Not know how, but human save Ressinter life!
All Roads to Peace#096.dst: ¡Humano curar a Ressinter! No saber cómo, ¡pero humano salvar vida de Ressinter!
All Roads to Peace#096.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#097.src: Told Bitteliso. Human learning! Save life of orc, even though idiot Villager say kill.
All Roads to Peace#097.dst: Decir a Bitteliso. ¡Humano aprender! Salvar vida de orco, aunque aldeano idiota decir matar.
All Roads to Peace#097.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#098.src: ...how. How. HOW! How human so good at healing?! Why human help?
All Roads to Peace#098.dst: ...cómo. Cómo. ¡CÓMO! ¿¡Cómo humano tan buen sanador!? ¿Por qué humano ayudar?
All Roads to Peace#098.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#099.src: Can trust human. Human try unlearn bad villager teach.
All Roads to Peace#099.dst: Poder confiar en humano. Humano intentar desaprender lo malo de aldeano.
All Roads to Peace#099.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#100.src: ...fine. Good human, not stupid human. Bitteliso sorry for beating. Here.
All Roads to Peace#100.dst: ...vale. Humano bueno, no humano estúpido. Bitteliso sentir paliza. Toma.
All Roads to Peace#100.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#101.src: Shouldn't we get back to what we were doing?
All Roads to Peace#101.dst: ¿No deberíamos volver a lo que estábamos haciendo?
All Roads to Peace#101.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#102.src: ...will stay in case Ressinter need help.
All Roads to Peace#102.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#103.src: Ressinter not old man! No need sitter!
All Roads to Peace#103.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#104.src: Not know that human actually good at heal! Very good! Healer, not hunter. More orc trust you now.
All Roads to Peace#104.dst: ¡No saber que humano bueno curando de verdad! ¡Muy bueno! Sanador, no cazador. Ahora más orcos confiar en ti.
All Roads to Peace#104.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#105.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow!
All Roads to Peace#105.dst: Ya que orcos confiar... quizá poder hablar con Arrai-Veretel ahora. ¡Seguir!
All Roads to Peace#105.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#106.src: Follow Zuett through the Orcish Fortress
All Roads to Peace#106.dst: Sigue a Zuett por la Fortaleza Orca

All Roads to Peace#107.src: No enter! Much camp see human heal, but still no trust human!
All Roads to Peace#107.dst: ¡No entrar! Mucho campamento ver humano curar, ¡pero aún no confiar!
All Roads to Peace#107.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#108.src: Ureietun! Human help save Ressinter life! Why no trust?
All Roads to Peace#108.dst: ¡Ureietun! ¡Humano ayudar a salvar a Ressinter! ¿Por qué no confiar?
All Roads to Peace#108.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#109.src: Human being led by you. Human led by villager too! Teach good thing, yes, but what if human just copying?
All Roads to Peace#109.dst: Humano guiado por ti. ¡Humano también guiado por aldeano! Enseñar bien, sí, pero ¿y si humano solo copiar?
All Roads to Peace#109.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#110.src: Human can earn trust alone! Zuett, stay in Arrai-room.
All Roads to Peace#110.dst: ¡Humano ganar confianza solo! Zuett, quedarse en sala de Arrai.
All Roads to Peace#110.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#112.src: RRRRRGH! STUPID ZUETT! WAR HAPPEN FOR REASON! GO AWAY!
All Roads to Peace#112.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#113.src: ...can trust human not kill. Human can walk around Centerworld. But human no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#113.dst: ...poder confiar en que humano no matar. Humano andar por Centerworld. ¡Pero no ver a Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#113.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#114.src: Ask various orcs if they need any help at the Orcish Fortress at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
All Roads to Peace#114.dst: Pregunta a varios orcos si necesitan ayuda en la Fortaleza Orca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

All Roads to Peace#115.src: Hm! Human, hunter, healer, halfwit soldier. Many things! Human also runner?
All Roads to Peace#115.dst: ¡Mmm! Humano, cazador, sanador, soldado bobo. ¡Mucho! ¿Humano también corredor?
All Roads to Peace#115.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#116.src: Peloros from Holehold. Camp home to messengers and runners. Have thing to deliver to Fruludir in green tower.
All Roads to Peace#116.dst: Peloros de Holehold. Campamento de mensajeros y corredores. Tener cosa que entregar a Fruludir en torre verde.
All Roads to Peace#116.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#117.src: Human do instead. Want see if human able. Supposed to be soldier- soldier must run to battlefield fast!
All Roads to Peace#117.dst: Humano hacer por mí. Querer ver si humano capaz. Ser soldado- ¡soldado deber correr rápido a batalla!
All Roads to Peace#117.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#118.src: Then human run fast to green tower- deliver in {~} seconds! Or else come back. Not urgent delivery, so delay fine.
All Roads to Peace#118.dst: Pues humano correr a torre verde- ¡entregar en {~} segundos! Si no, volver. No urgente, retraso bien.
All Roads to Peace#118.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#119.src: Will know human delivered in time. How? Human will see if run fast!
All Roads to Peace#119.dst: Saber si humano entregar a tiempo. ¿Cómo? ¡Humano ver si correr rápido!
All Roads to Peace#119.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#120.src: RGH! Can understand just fine, just not speak as good! No mock us!
All Roads to Peace#120.dst: ¡RGH! ¡Entender bien, solo no hablar tan bien! ¡No burlarse!
All Roads to Peace#120.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#121.src: Hm! Human have Peloros box. Peloros give human run training. Give here.
All Roads to Peace#121.dst: ¡Mmm! Humano tener caja de Peloros. Peloros dar entreno de carrera. Dar aquí.
All Roads to Peace#121.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#122.src: More than Zuett with human? Good sign. Maybe fighting stop soon.
All Roads to Peace#122.dst: ¿Más que Zuett con humano? Buena señal. Quizá lucha parar pronto.
All Roads to Peace#122.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#123.src: Patience, human. Box full of signal flare. Will light one to show Peloros human got here in time.
All Roads to Peace#123.dst: Paciencia, humano. Caja llena de bengalas. Encender una para que Peloros ver humano llegar a tiempo.
All Roads to Peace#123.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#124.src: Saw the firework. Human did well, finishing single morning exercise!
All Roads to Peace#124.dst: Ver fuegos artificiales. ¡Humano hacer bien, acabar ejercicio de mañana!
All Roads to Peace#124.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#125.src: Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#125.dst: Orco entrenar mucho para estar fuerte. ¡Corredores orcos deber ser rápidos y no cansarse para ser Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#125.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#126.src: Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
All Roads to Peace#126.dst: Toma. Humano coger. Entrenar más. Quizá visitar Holehold- también sitio para relajarse. Aguante bueno para todo.
All Roads to Peace#126.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#128.src: Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
All Roads to Peace#128.dst: Oh. Humano que ayudar a Ressinter. Ser raro. Nada como otros humanos.
All Roads to Peace#128.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#129.src: This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
All Roads to Peace#129.dst: ¿Esto? Almacén de comida. Sobre todo carne y raíces. Aunque pronto gran ritual.
All Roads to Peace#129.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#130.src: Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
All Roads to Peace#130.dst: Fiesta con Earthpit. Llegar pronto- así que guardar comida para eso.
All Roads to Peace#130.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#131.src: ...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
All Roads to Peace#131.dst: ...humano parecer querer ayudar. Ser... muy raro. Supongo... si querer ayudar con comida, poder pescar.
All Roads to Peace#131.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#132.src: Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
All Roads to Peace#132.dst: No pedir todo a humano- solo [{~} Carp Meat] basta. Aunque poder traer más si querer.
All Roads to Peace#132.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#133.src: If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
All Roads to Peace#133.dst: Si querer traer más de {~}, aceptar más de {~}.
All Roads to Peace#133.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#134.src: Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
All Roads to Peace#134.dst: Ajá, ajá. Ser humano raro, pero no malo. Bastante carne.
All Roads to Peace#134.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#135.src: Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
All Roads to Peace#135.dst: Fiesta aún lejos, pero toma. Humano ayudar, así que recibir premio. Ser justo.
All Roads to Peace#135.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#137.src: Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
All Roads to Peace#137.dst: Oh, traer más pescado del pedido. ¡El doble!
All Roads to Peace#137.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#138.src: You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
All Roads to Peace#138.dst: Ser buen humano. Raro, pero no malo. Dispuesto a esforzarse más.
All Roads to Peace#138.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#139.src: Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
All Roads to Peace#139.dst: Toma- compartir también carne que no ser para fiesta. Y otros premios.
All Roads to Peace#139.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#141.src: ...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
All Roads to Peace#141.dst: ...eso ser... mucho pescado. Decir cinco, ¿oír bien?
All Roads to Peace#141.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#142.src: Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
All Roads to Peace#142.dst: Cuatro veces lo justo. ¿Por qué humano así?
All Roads to Peace#142.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#143.src: Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
All Roads to Peace#143.dst: Humanos deber ser egoístas. Escuchar a aldeano y matar orco. Pero tú nada así.
All Roads to Peace#143.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#144.src: Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
All Roads to Peace#144.dst: Pues toma- Compartir carne extra. No para fiesta, pero buena. Y otra cosa. Muchas gracias, humano.
All Roads to Peace#144.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#147.src: Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
All Roads to Peace#147.dst: Decir cinco. Tener treinta. Yo... cómo y por qué.
All Roads to Peace#147.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#148.src: You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
All Roads to Peace#148.dst: Hacer trabajo de seis orcos. Ser... humano exagerado. ¡Pero no ser malo!
All Roads to Peace#148.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#149.src: Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
All Roads to Peace#149.dst: Pues toma. Carne no para fiesta, ¡pero merecer buena comida por tanto esfuerzo!
All Roads to Peace#149.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#150.src: That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
All Roads to Peace#150.dst: ¡Tanto pescado cubrir cupo! ¡Muchas gracias, humano raro y amable!
All Roads to Peace#150.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#152.src: Hey! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
All Roads to Peace#152.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Humano que cazar jabalí lomoespín y ayudar a curar sanador!
All Roads to Peace#152.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#153.src: Not stupid human who go around and kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
All Roads to Peace#153.dst: ¡No humano estúpido que ir matando orcos! ¡Buen humano! Poder confiar. Así que pedir cosa pequeña.
All Roads to Peace#153.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#154.src: Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#154.dst: ¡Humano OFRECER ayuda- Jmh! ¡Muy buen humano! Tarea simple. Sureste de fuerte, tras cresta, viejo campamento de Teiren.
All Roads to Peace#154.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#155.src: Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
All Roads to Peace#155.dst: Vivir allí, pero irse porque Freelancer saltar desde montaña. ¡Olvidar cosa importante allí!
All Roads to Peace#155.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#156.src: Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#156.dst: Tener que quedarse, vigilar que Peloros tonto no correr a hoguera. Ya pasar. ¡Así que ir tú!
All Roads to Peace#156.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#157.src: Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
All Roads to Peace#157.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#158.src: Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
All Roads to Peace#158.dst: ¡Ni hablar, cobarde espíritu del viento! ¡Esto ahora es mío!
All Roads to Peace#158.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#159.src: Lady, everything the wind touches is OURS! Not ta mention we're so close to the mountains we live on! This camp's our property, and that thing you got's part of our camp!
All Roads to Peace#159.dst: ¡Señora, todo lo que toca el viento es NUESTRO! ¡Y encima estamos al lado de nuestras montañas! Este campamento es nuestro, ¡y eso que tienes es parte de él!
All Roads to Peace#159.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#160.src: Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
All Roads to Peace#160.dst: ¡Tonterías! Lo construyeron quienes respetaban la tierra y sus frutos. Ahora que se han ido, la naturaleza puede reclamarlo, ¡como es justo!
All Roads to Peace#160.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#161.src: Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
All Roads to Peace#161.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Eso es todo? Eres un bombón, nena, pero te corto los pétalos si no lo sueltas ya.
All Roads to Peace#161.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#162.src: What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
All Roads to Peace#162.dst: ¡Qué bruto zafio, amenazar a una encarnación de la naturaleza! ¡No lo entregaré sin luchar!
All Roads to Peace#162.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#163.src: One so brazen as yourself could never share in the bounties of nature! Now begone! And leave me be!
All Roads to Peace#163.dst: ¡Alguien tan descarado jamás compartirá los frutos de la naturaleza! ¡Largo! ¡Déjame en paz!
All Roads to Peace#163.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#164.src: ...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
All Roads to Peace#164.dst: ...¿mm? ¿Y tú quién eres? ¿Qué trae a un humano a este lugar abandonado?
All Roads to Peace#164.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#165.src: Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
All Roads to Peace#165.dst: ¡Oh, no! ¿¡Tú también lo quieres!? ¡Lo he reclamado para mí! ¡Déjame en paz, vete! ¡Fuera de aquí!
All Roads to Peace#165.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#166.src: Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
All Roads to Peace#166.dst: ¡No debiste enfrentarte a mí, muñeca! ¿¡La próxima vez recuerda quién esparce tu polen, eh!? Ahora a subir esto a la montaña...
All Roads to Peace#166.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#167.src: OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
All Roads to Peace#167.dst: ¡EH! ¿Y ESTE payaso quién es? ¿Vienes a vaciar tu cartera para mí o qué?
All Roads to Peace#167.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#168.src: What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
All Roads to Peace#168.dst: ¿Qué, tú también quieres esto? ¡Es mío, ¿me oyes?! ¡MÍO! ¡No te lo llevarás!
All Roads to Peace#168.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#169.src: Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
All Roads to Peace#169.dst: ¡Humano! Acertar al mandar. ¡Peloros caer de silla y casi quemarse! ¿Encontrar cosa? Muy peculiar, única cosa en campamento.
All Roads to Peace#169.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#170.src: Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
All Roads to Peace#170.dst: ¡¡Jmjm!! ¡Sí! ¡Esto buscar! ¡Muy buen humano! ¡Humano merecer premio por ser bueno!
All Roads to Peace#170.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#171.src: Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
All Roads to Peace#171.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#172.src: Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
All Roads to Peace#172.dst: ¡Tonto! Si humano no saber qué ser, ¡no decir! Aprender solo.
All Roads to Peace#172.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#176.src: Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
All Roads to Peace#176.dst: ¡Jrrh! ¡Humano! ¡Tu idioma tonto! Nombre listo, fluir como agua en orco, ¡en letra humana parecer montón de estiércol!
All Roads to Peace#176.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#177.src: Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
All Roads to Peace#177.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#178.src: NO! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
All Roads to Peace#178.dst: ¡NO! ¡Decir mal, todo mal! ¡Sonar más tonto de lo normal!
All Roads to Peace#178.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#179.src: GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
All Roads to Peace#179.dst: ¡GRRRH! ¡Nombre confuso! ¡En orco no confuso! ¡Humano decir todo mal!
All Roads to Peace#179.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#180.src: Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
All Roads to Peace#180.dst: Jmh. Eso, humano. Al menos intentar. ¿Ver qué feo nombre escrito?
All Roads to Peace#180.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#181.src: Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
All Roads to Peace#181.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#182.src: Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
All Roads to Peace#182.dst: Toma. Necesitar enfadarse con idioma tonto, no con humano.
All Roads to Peace#182.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#184.src: Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
All Roads to Peace#184.dst: ¡Tonto tonto TONTO! ¡Nada como escribir! ¿¡Ver idioma tonto ahora!?
All Roads to Peace#184.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#185.src: GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
All Roads to Peace#185.dst: ¡¡GAAAH!! ¡¡¡No, no, no, no!!! ¿¡Por qué aprender idioma humano!?
All Roads to Peace#185.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#186.src: NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#186.dst: ¡NOMBRE NO JOE! ¿¡QUÉ NOMBRE SER JOE!? ¡JOE NOMBRE TONTO! ¡¡AAAH!!
All Roads to Peace#186.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#191.src: Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
All Roads to Peace#191.dst: Roca atascada. Intentar alzar- ¡entrenar fuerza! Nadie poder alzar roca.
All Roads to Peace#191.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#192.src: Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
All Roads to Peace#192.dst: ¡Yunelsu intentar tirar roca al río! Tirar otras rocas, esta no.
All Roads to Peace#192.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#194.src: Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
All Roads to Peace#194.dst: Mmm... magia de humano fuerte, pero roca no moverse.
All Roads to Peace#194.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#195.src: Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
All Roads to Peace#195.dst: ¡Juntos! Lanzar magia a roca, ¡yo intentar levantar! ¡Listo!
All Roads to Peace#195.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#197.src: Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
All Roads to Peace#197.dst: Jrrgh... Jrrf. Deber ser... roca antigua.
All Roads to Peace#197.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#198.src: Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
All Roads to Peace#198.dst: Aquí mucho tiempo. Atascada, roca donde tierra querer.
All Roads to Peace#198.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#199.src: Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
All Roads to Peace#199.dst: Yunelsu buscar otra roca. Aunque a veces roca romperse.
All Roads to Peace#199.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#200.src: See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
All Roads to Peace#200.dst: ¿Ver? Mucha roca rota. Oír que servir para armadura. Coger tú.
All Roads to Peace#200.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#202.src: Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
All Roads to Peace#202.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Tú! Ver a Zuett arrastrarte a campamento. Y ver otra cosa.
All Roads to Peace#202.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#203.src: And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#203.dst: ¡Y ayudar a Ressinter! Disculparse luego. Ser culpa mía. ¿Humano ver Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#203.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#204.src: Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
All Roads to Peace#204.dst: Freelancers creer que todo ser suyo. Rondar mucho fortaleza, a veces intentar saltar dentro.
All Roads to Peace#204.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#205.src: Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
All Roads to Peace#205.dst: Intentar derribar uno volador, pero cañón romperse y bala explotar.
All Roads to Peace#205.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#206.src: Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
All Roads to Peace#206.dst: Ressinter bien, pero aún reparar cañón. Si humano querer ayudar, necesitar [{~} Iron Ingots] para reparar.
All Roads to Peace#206.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#207.src: Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
All Roads to Peace#207.dst: Camino largo, pero hierro en valle al este de cantera aldeana. También otros aldeanos allí, con armas. No saber por qué.
All Roads to Peace#207.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#208.src: Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
All Roads to Peace#208.dst: Humano ayudar de forma rara. ¡Pero bueno! Hacer más fácil trabajo de Lomoster de disparar enemigo.
All Roads to Peace#208.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#209.src: Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
All Roads to Peace#209.dst: Toma. Freelancer robar metal y más cosas, encontrar mucho al disparar. Humano quedárselo.
All Roads to Peace#209.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#210.src: Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
All Roads to Peace#210.dst: No servir para reparar cañón, pero seguro servir para hacer otra cosa.
All Roads to Peace#210.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#212.src: Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language, pfeh. Whatever language, not orc language.
All Roads to Peace#212.dst: Grrmb. Kreimu tonta. Idioma Wynn tonto... idioma de Gavel, bah. Da igual idioma, no ser orco.
All Roads to Peace#212.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#213.src: Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
All Roads to Peace#213.dst: Su nombre, mi nombre, sonar igual. ¡En orco no sonar igual! ¡Pero en TU idioma, sonar igual!
All Roads to Peace#213.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#214.src: Not just that-learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
All Roads to Peace#214.dst: No solo eso- aprender a ser orco médico. ¡Ella también! Sanadora, boticaria, herbolaria, lo que sea. ¡Demasiado igual!
All Roads to Peace#214.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#215.src: Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu, ingredient for medicine.
All Roads to Peace#215.dst: Enfadar eso. Distraer de entrenar. ¿Humano ayudar como a Ressinter? Traer a Creinu- Crei...nu...no Kreimu, ingrediente para medicina.
All Roads to Peace#215.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#216.src: [{~} Leafy Stalks]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
All Roads to Peace#216.dst: [{~} Leafy Stalks]. Necesitar aprender a hacer mucha medicina con poca hierba. ¿Fácil?
All Roads to Peace#216.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#217.src: Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
All Roads to Peace#217.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#218.src: Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
All Roads to Peace#218.dst: Bien. Poder coger estos- chica Alraune tener a veces. Sabrosos, pero no buena medicina.
All Roads to Peace#218.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#219.src: Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
All Roads to Peace#219.dst: A Durbeo quizá gustar. Durbeo orco en torre almacén detrás de mí. ¿Quizá querer ayuda también?
All Roads to Peace#219.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#221.src: Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
All Roads to Peace#221.dst: Oh, el humano que curó a Ressinter. Sí, ya he oído hablar de ti. Aquí las noticias vuelan.
All Roads to Peace#221.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#222.src: You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
All Roads to Peace#222.dst: Tienes una cara rara. Eh, quiero decir, una expresión rara. ¿Qué, no estás hecho a un orco elocuente?
All Roads to Peace#222.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#223.src: I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
All Roads to Peace#223.dst: Estudio idiomas, por eso. Aún no lo sé todo, así que si te apetece ayudar, me vendría bien.
All Roads to Peace#223.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#224.src: I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they've left behind any language books.
All Roads to Peace#224.dst: Tenía un amigo hobbit muy listo que vivía cerca. Se marchó, pero quiero que mires en su madriguera por si dejó libros de idiomas.
All Roads to Peace#224.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#225.src: It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
All Roads to Peace#225.dst: Debería estar cerca de la torre azul de la colina. Es fácil, ¿no?
All Roads to Peace#225.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#226.src: Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
All Roads to Peace#226.dst: Oh, bien, sí dejaron un libro. Así completo mi colección. Tengo el primer, segundo, cuarto, quinto y sexto tomo.
All Roads to Peace#226.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#227.src: Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
All Roads to Peace#227.dst: Ojalá aprenda algo nuevo aquí. Aún no entiendo qué significan todas esas raras "expresiones hechas"...
All Roads to Peace#227.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#228.src: What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
All Roads to Peace#228.dst: ¿Qué significa "echar los hígados"? ¿O "en un santiamén"? En fin. Seguro que lo sabes, así que adivinar es aburrido.
All Roads to Peace#228.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#229.src: Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
All Roads to Peace#229.dst: Toma, pues. Ese amigo apuntaba todo lo que veía en unos diarios y me los dio para guardarlos, pero no puedo leerlos.
All Roads to Peace#229.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#230.src: The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
All Roads to Peace#230.dst: Las páginas son muy frágiles- las rompería al pasarlas. Menos mal que el libro que me diste es de cuero resistente, pero aún debo tener cuidado...
All Roads to Peace#230.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#231.src: Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things for yourself.
All Roads to Peace#231.dst: Bueno, quizá si lees lo que pone en ellos puedas aprender algo por tu cuenta.
All Roads to Peace#231.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#233.src: Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
All Roads to Peace#233.dst: Vaya. Tú otra vez. El humano raro que ayudó a Ressinter. ¿Pasa algo?
All Roads to Peace#233.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#234.src: Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
All Roads to Peace#234.dst: Mmm. ¿Aún quieres ayudar? ¿Qué te pasa con eso de ayudar? No estoy acostumbrado. Pero se me ocurre algo.
All Roads to Peace#234.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#235.src: HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
All Roads to Peace#235.dst: ¡EH! ¿Alguno de vosotros quiere jugar a algo?
All Roads to Peace#235.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#236.src: Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!

All Roads to Peace#237.src: What in the... HEY! Why's one of the big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
All Roads to Peace#237.dst: Pero qué... ¡EH! ¿¡Por qué hay aquí uno de esos humanos grandes y temibles!? Nunny, ¡dijiste que íbamos a jugar!

All Roads to Peace#238.src: We are. This human actually isn't so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
All Roads to Peace#238.dst: Y vamos a jugar. Este humano no es tan malo. ¿Os presentáis?
All Roads to Peace#238.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#239.src: Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
All Roads to Peace#239.dst: Bueno, vale, pero... aunque digas que este no da tanto miedo, ¡no quiero decirle mi nombre real!

All Roads to Peace#240.src: Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
All Roads to Peace#240.dst: ¿No acabamos de comer un montón de fruta? ¡Usémosla de nombres falsos!

All Roads to Peace#241.src: Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
All Roads to Peace#241.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#242.src: I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
All Roads to Peace#242.dst: Acabo de comer muchos arándanos, así que supongo que ahora soy Blueberry.
All Roads to Peace#242.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#243.src: Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
All Roads to Peace#243.dst: ¡Eh, a mí no me importa que me llamen Grapes!
All Roads to Peace#243.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#244.src: Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
All Roads to Peace#244.dst: ¡Pues yo soy Peaches! ¿Solo vamos a jugar al escondite?
All Roads to Peace#244.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#245.src: Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
All Roads to Peace#245.dst: Sí. Escondeos en algún sitio del fuerte. Si el humano no os encuentra, ganáis.
All Roads to Peace#245.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#246.src: Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
All Roads to Peace#246.dst: Bueno, qué aburrido, así que buscaré un sitio muy difícil de alcanzar.
All Roads to Peace#246.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#248.src: Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
All Roads to Peace#248.dst: Bueno, ahí lo tienes. Si hablas conmigo, te diré cuántos te quedan por encontrar.
All Roads to Peace#248.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#249.src: ...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
All Roads to Peace#249.dst: ...vaya. Eres bueno. Pensé que quizá me verías aquí arriba, ¡pero no que podrías llegar!
All Roads to Peace#249.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#250.src: I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
All Roads to Peace#250.dst: No me importa que seas humano. Mientras me entretenga, soy feliz. Lo cual no es tan genial, porque aquí no hay mucho con lo que trastear.
All Roads to Peace#250.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#251.src: Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
All Roads to Peace#251.dst: En Tinkernook hay muchas más máquinas, metales y cosas para experimentar y construir que aquí.
All Roads to Peace#251.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#252.src: Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
All Roads to Peace#252.dst: En fin, tú ganas, yo pierdo, así que vuelvo con el aguafiestas de Nunexetor. ¡Hasta luego!
All Roads to Peace#252.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#253.src: NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
All Roads to Peace#253.dst: ¡ÑAC! ¡Para ser un humano tan grande, sabes acercarte a hurtadillas!
All Roads to Peace#253.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#254.src: Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
All Roads to Peace#254.dst: Uf, por un momento creí que estaba perdido... Si Nunny dice que eres de fiar, le creo, ¡pero no das menos miedo!
All Roads to Peace#254.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#255.src: And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
All Roads to Peace#255.dst: Y supongo que aquí a la vista, los otros orcos no te dejarían abusar de nosotros, así que...
All Roads to Peace#255.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#256.src: Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
All Roads to Peace#256.dst: Quizá no estés mal. Aun así, me has encontrado, así que pierdo. ¡A menos que no encuentres a los demás!
All Roads to Peace#256.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#257.src: I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
All Roads to Peace#257.dst: ¡Seguro que NUNCA encuentras a Mango, jajaja! ¡Siempre se toma estos juegos SÚPER en serio!
All Roads to Peace#257.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#258.src: Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
All Roads to Peace#258.dst: Ay, jo. Supongo que aquí arriba se me ve fácilmente.
All Roads to Peace#258.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#259.src: I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
All Roads to Peace#259.dst: Bueno, ya lo sabía, ¡pero no pensé que se te ocurriría subir a la torre!
All Roads to Peace#259.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#260.src: Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
All Roads to Peace#260.dst: En fin... ¿de verdad intentaste curar a Ressinter? ¡Eso es admirable!
All Roads to Peace#260.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#261.src: I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu back at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
All Roads to Peace#261.dst: Dicen que casi todos los humanos son abusones. Por eso Veltu, del campamento Trunkstump, nos hacía más duros.
All Roads to Peace#261.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#262.src: Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
All Roads to Peace#262.dst: ¡Y entoooonces un humano fue y la mató, supongo que porque se lo mandaron! Al menos tú pareces medio decente.
All Roads to Peace#262.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#263.src: Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
All Roads to Peace#263.dst: En fin, ¡vuelvo con el viejo gruñón callado!
All Roads to Peace#263.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#264.src: Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
All Roads to Peace#264.dst: ¡Ay! ¡Creía que no me verías detrás de la escalera!
All Roads to Peace#264.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#265.src: Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
All Roads to Peace#265.dst: Uf, vosotros... los humanos dais miedo de cerca. ¿Nunexetor está seguro de que no eres malo?
All Roads to Peace#265.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#266.src: I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
All Roads to Peace#266.dst: Digo, ¡mira tu armadura! ¡Pareces capaz de aplastarme contra la pared en un segundo!
All Roads to Peace#266.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#267.src: ...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
All Roads to Peace#267.dst: ...creo que acabo de darte una idea y no me quedo a comprobarlo. ¡Tú ganas!
All Roads to Peace#267.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#268.src: Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
All Roads to Peace#268.dst: Parece que gana el humano. Ya sé cómo lograste encontrar ese jabalí lomoespín.
All Roads to Peace#268.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#269.src: There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
All Roads to Peace#269.dst: Es imposible que DE VERDAD cazaras uno de esos. ¡Hasta los cazadores orcos lo pasan mal!
All Roads to Peace#269.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#270.src: Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
All Roads to Peace#270.dst: ¿Me tomas el pelo? ¡Los humanos dan miedo, Blueberry! ¡Han cazado cosas mucho más fuertes que un cerdo tonto!
All Roads to Peace#270.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#271.src: But, the game was fun, right?
All Roads to Peace#271.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#272.src: Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I'd thought.
All Roads to Peace#272.dst: Sí, supongo que no fue tan aburrido como pensaba.
All Roads to Peace#272.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#273.src: That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
All Roads to Peace#273.dst: Eso es todo lo que quería. Ya podéis volver a lo que estuvierais haciendo.
All Roads to Peace#273.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#274.src: Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
All Roads to Peace#274.dst: ¡Sí, por fin! ¡Ya no tengo que preguntarme si el humano va a sacarme los ojos!
All Roads to Peace#274.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#275.src: Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
All Roads to Peace#275.dst: Oh, no seas tan miedica. ¡Este es majo!
All Roads to Peace#275.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#276.src: Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
All Roads to Peace#276.dst: ¡Buen juego, supongo! A aburrirse otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#276.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#280.src: What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
All Roads to Peace#280.dst: ¿Qué? Si ni siquiera llevas zapatos de esos.
All Roads to Peace#280.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#281.src: Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
All Roads to Peace#281.dst: En fin, al vencedor, el botín. Toma, por entretenerlos un rato.
All Roads to Peace#281.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#282.src: They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#282.dst: Me hacen vigilar a los goblins, pero no se me da bien divertirlos, así que supongo que gracias.
All Roads to Peace#282.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#284.src: Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
All Roads to Peace#284.dst: Ah, el humano raro. ¿Por qué querer ayudar?
All Roads to Peace#284.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#285.src: Must be some reason. Not sure if tired for fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
All Roads to Peace#285.dst: Deber haber razón. No saber si cansado de luchar u otra razón, pero si humano querer ayudar, venir bien ayuda.
All Roads to Peace#285.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#286.src: Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
All Roads to Peace#286.dst: Quedar poco tinte azul. Tener muchos otros colores, pero necesitar azul. Saber dónde conseguir.
All Roads to Peace#286.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#287.src: The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
All Roads to Peace#287.dst: Cueva junto a puente aldeano, con estanque y arco al lado. Entrar, y haber flores azules.
All Roads to Peace#287.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#288.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
All Roads to Peace#288.dst: Traer [{~} Terramarine Buds] para hacer más tintes. No saber por qué ayudar, pero no rechazar ayuda.
All Roads to Peace#288.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#289.src: The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
All Roads to Peace#289.dst: ¿Humano raro otra vez? Estar cubierto de polvo azul. ¡Encontrar flores!
All Roads to Peace#289.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#290.src: Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
All Roads to Peace#290.dst: Toma. Quedarme eso. Capullos bastar para lo que necesitar, pero tú quedarte polvo.
All Roads to Peace#290.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#291.src: Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
All Roads to Peace#291.dst: Y algo más. Pero, otra vez- ¿por qué querer ayudar? No entender. Humanos matar muchos orcos.
All Roads to Peace#291.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#292.src: You unlearn villager stupidity maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
All Roads to Peace#292.dst: ¿Quizá desaprender estupidez aldeana? ¿A mitad de desaprender? Quizá señal de tierra de que todo sanar. Quizá no. Ya ver.
All Roads to Peace#292.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#294.src: You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
All Roads to Peace#294.dst: ¿Tú humano raro que ayudar en vez de matar? Nunexetor y goblins pequeños hablar de ti.
All Roads to Peace#294.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#295.src: Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
All Roads to Peace#295.dst: Intentar mejorar armas y herramientas. Entrenar, pero acabar piedras de afilar. Etemitoro- ese ser yo, mi nombre... ¿Así decir?
All Roads to Peace#295.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#296.src: Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
All Roads to Peace#296.dst: Idioma humano raro. En fin, saber dónde buena piedra de afilar- cima de montaña al este de fortaleza.
All Roads to Peace#296.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#297.src: There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
All Roads to Peace#297.dst: Atajo por cima junto a cueva Ledant. Quizá peligroso, pero no mucho. Seguir arbustos secos en camino y llegar rápido a cima.
All Roads to Peace#297.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#298.src: May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
All Roads to Peace#298.dst: Quizá tener algo útil si traer [Leaden Stone] para afilar metal.
All Roads to Peace#298.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#299.src: Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
All Roads to Peace#299.dst: Mira- ¿humano querer ayudar? Pues traer a Etemitoro- ese yo, mi nombre... Traer-
All Roads to Peace#299.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#300.src: Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
All Roads to Peace#300.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Tener [Leaden Stone]! Concentrado en trabajo, no ver.
All Roads to Peace#300.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#301.src: Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
All Roads to Peace#301.dst: Toma. A humano gustar gema verde por dinero, ¿no? Pero no servir para forjar.
All Roads to Peace#301.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#302.src: Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other good weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
All Roads to Peace#302.dst: Piezas de arma rotas no servir solas, pero aún afiladas. ¡Poder hacer otras buenas armas! Reusar bueno para tierra- ¡no desperdiciar!
All Roads to Peace#302.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#304.src: Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
All Roads to Peace#304.dst: Mmm, humano sanador. Jurar que ver andar por llanuras hace tiempo. ¿Qué hacer aquí? ¿Ressinter herido otra vez?
All Roads to Peace#304.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#305.src: No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
All Roads to Peace#305.dst: ¿No? Bueno, ahora tener curiosidad. Tú curar a Ressinter... ¿suerte? ¿O humano saber de verdad qué hacer hierbas?
All Roads to Peace#305.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#306.src: Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
All Roads to Peace#306.dst: Querer examinar. Ver saber médico de humano. Hacer preguntas, humano responder. Simple. ¿Listo?
All Roads to Peace#306.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#307.src: Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
All Roads to Peace#307.dst: ¡Bien! Primera pregunta. Hoja de ginkgo. ¿Para qué servir hoja de ginkgo?
All Roads to Peace#307.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#308.src: Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
All Roads to Peace#308.dst: ¡Sí! Bien. Hoja de ginkgo ayudar cerebro. Aliviar estrés, pero hacer sangre líquida. A veces bueno, pero poder ser peligroso.
All Roads to Peace#308.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#309.src: So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
All Roads to Peace#309.dst: Segunda pregunta. Mirto de Brabante. ¿Para qué servir mirto?
All Roads to Peace#309.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#310.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#310.dst: No. Mirto no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#310.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#311.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#311.dst: No. Mirto no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#311.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#312.src: Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp makes bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
All Roads to Peace#312.dst: Ajá. ¡Bien! Pulpa de mirto espantar bichos. También calmar piel irritada. Muy bueno para picaduras.
All Roads to Peace#312.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#313.src: Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
All Roads to Peace#313.dst: Tercera pregunta. Saúco. Saúco servir para dos cosas. ¿Para qué servir saúco?
All Roads to Peace#313.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#314.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#314.dst: No, saúco no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#314.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#315.src: Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
All Roads to Peace#315.dst: ¡Sí! Aunque saúco servir para tercera cosa. ¡Hacer buena bebida! Emborrachar si fermentar, pero eso no medicina.
All Roads to Peace#315.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#316.src: Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
All Roads to Peace#316.dst: Última pregunta para humano. Matricaria. ¿Con qué NO ayudar matricaria?
All Roads to Peace#316.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#317.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#317.dst: Matricaria muy buena para curar eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#317.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#318.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#318.dst: Matricaria muy buena para curar eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#318.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#321.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: Eso... ¡acertar! ¡No correcto, pero acertar! Tú... jaja, tú solo ayudar a Ressinter por suerte, ¿no? Humano no ser sanador.
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: ¡Pero humano tener humor! Y humano esforzarse por ayudar. Más que casi todos humanos. Toma- intentar curar más, en vez de ser soldado.
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#323.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: Mundo necesitar más gente que ayudar a otros. Que humano querer intentar significar muchas cosas buenas.
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#324.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: No, saúco no servir para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#325.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: No. Hoja de ginkgo mala para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#326.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: No. Hoja de ginkgo mala para eso. Mmm, quizá humano curar a Ressinter por suerte... Poder intentar otra vez.
All Roads to Peace#326.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#327.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#327.dst: Vale. Tomarse tiempo. Estar aquí un rato para asegurar que otro sanador bien.
All Roads to Peace#327.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#329.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: ¡Humano sanador! ¡Hola! Esto torre de Onluk. ¡Torre de Onluk dos! Humano ayudar, humano bienvenido.
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#330.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: ¡Torre uno llamar torre uno porque Onluk construir torre uno! Este no sitio normal de Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#331.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: Normalmente en torre de colina pequeña, cruzando puente. Pero construir torre solo, torre tambalear.
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#332.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#332.dst: Humano ayudar. ¿Humano traer madera resistente para arreglar torre? {p} tener madera resistente. Bosque también, pero más mágica que resistente.
All Roads to Peace#332.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#333.src: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#333.dst: [{~} Willow Planks] quizá bastar para mejorar torre. ¡Sauce madera fuerte! ¿Poder traer?
All Roads to Peace#333.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#334.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Humano tener madera de sauce! ¡Onluk arreglar torre ya!
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#335.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: ¡Reparar torre de Onluk uno! ¡Venir a ver tras arreglar!
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#336.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#336.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#337.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#337.dst: ¡Deber ir a ver! ¡Subir a torre, disparar ballesta a Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#337.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#338.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: ¿Ver? ¡Torre de Onluk uno mucho mejor que torre dos! Aquí arriba cómodo, ¡y ver torre de Fruludir también!
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#339.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#339.dst: Humano muy útil. ¡Sanador y leñador! Reparador de torre- Bueno, humano no reparar torre. ¡Ayudante de reparador de torre!
All Roads to Peace#339.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#340.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#340.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#342.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#342.dst: Habla con Ureietun en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para acceder a la choza de la cacica

All Roads to Peace#345.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#345.dst: Humano querer hablar con Arrai-Veretel. En choza. Seguir.
All Roads to Peace#345.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#346.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#346.dst: ¡Arrai-Veretel! Humano ayudar a orcos por fortaleza. Querer hablar.
All Roads to Peace#346.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#347.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#347.dst: Ahora cosa de humano. No ayudar más- decisión ser de Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#347.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#348.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#348.dst: Jmh. Zuett hablar de ti. ¿Así que tú humano que intentar acabar guerra?
All Roads to Peace#348.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#350.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#350.dst: ¡TÚ! ¡Tú humano que matar a Rai-Poxper! ¡Tú humano que atacar otro fuerte!
All Roads to Peace#350.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#351.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#351.dst: Necesitar hablar con Zuett otra vez. Tú seguir. Y tú callar. ¿Entender?
All Roads to Peace#351.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#352.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
