All Roads to Peace#352.dst: Sigue a Arrai-Veretel a la sala de reuniones en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#353.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#353.dst: ¡ZUETT! Decir humano querer paz. ¿¡Saber quién ser humano!?
All Roads to Peace#353.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#354.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: ¡Humano TAMBIÉN atacar otro fuerte! ¡Muchos orcos muertos por humano!
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#358.src: How can Zuett say human trying to end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: ¿Cómo Zuett decir humano querer paz, si EMPEZAR GUERRA OTRA VEZ?
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#360.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: ¡¡ESO. SER. LA. CLAVE!! ¡Aldeano hacer que humano luchar por él! Tregua decir aldeano no atacar orco. Humano cruzar océano. Intentar paz- ¡recibir ataque!
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#361.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, and Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#361.dst: Ver humano atacar. Aldeano hacer que humano atacar, mentir para engañar. Orcos defenderse. Luego, tres orcos Rai morir en Earthpit, Cliffhearth y campamento goblin Trunkstump.
All Roads to Peace#361.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#362.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#362.dst: ¡Humano atacar! Rai-Poxper cobrar precio justo por romper tregua, pero aún no guerra. Coger hacha mágica de ciudad aldeana mientras magia ir mal.
All Roads to Peace#362.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: Aldeano y humano atacar primero, ¡pero culpar a orco por cobrar lo justo! ¡Y humano matar a Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#363.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#364.src: Orc take human fort build in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#364.dst: Orco tomar fuerte humano en bosque de tierra moribunda. ¡No saber si humano planear otro ataque! Pero no matar humano. Retener humano.
All Roads to Peace#364.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#365.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: ¡Luego mismo humano venir, matar orco en baño, asaltar fuerte, matar muchos de Centerworld! ¡Aldeano empezar, orco acabar, aldeano no respetar final!
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#366.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: Sí, humano engañado por aldeano. Pero igual atacar orco. ¡Igual matar muchos orcos! ¿Y ahora humano querer paz?
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#367.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: ¿Qué hacer humano? ¿Cazar jabalí? ¿Ayudar sanador? ¿Hacer recados de orcos? Eso no compensar vidas perdidas.
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#368.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#368.dst: ...Arrai-Veretel tener razón. Lo bueno de humano no compensar eso. Pero humano seguir intentando. Si un humano intentar parar, más humanos poder intentar.
All Roads to Peace#368.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#369.src: War only killing us! If tried talk human instead of go sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#369.dst: ¡Guerra solo matarnos! Si hablar con humano en vez de afilar lanza y contraatacar, quizá humano aprender antes que ahora.
All Roads to Peace#369.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#370.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: Quizá. Quizá morir más orcos en cambio. Zuett, no poder saber qué pasar. Ser ilusión, ¡y yo también desear que pasar!
All Roads to Peace#370.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#371.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: ¡Pero con idioma Wynn a medias, orco no hablar bien! ¡TÚ intentar aprender idioma cuando idiota matarte! Todo sonar tonto, ¡y casi nadie tener tiempo!
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#372.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#372.dst: Pero humano escuchar a Zuett, aunque no sonar listo. Arrai-Veretel no respetar humano. Justificado, pero igual causar problema.
All Roads to Peace#372.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#373.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#373.dst: Grrh. ¡VALE! ¿Zuett querer tanto paz? ¿Humano querer tanto paz? Humano derramar mucha sangre orca. Única salida de guerra, atravesarla. Luchar.
All Roads to Peace#373.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#374.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: Sin trucos. Sin refuerzos. Nada más que batalla entre humano y yo. Si humano luchar en arena ritual y ganar, escuchar.
All Roads to Peace#374.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#375.src: Listen, Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: Escucha, Zuett. Yo también querer fin de guerra. Pero deber entender riesgo. No decidir a la ligera. Aldeano faltar a palabra- ver escrito, buscar forma de esquivar escrito.
All Roads to Peace#375.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#376.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: ¡Amenazarnos con máquina de cadáver de hierro! Así que haber batalla. Preparar ritual y público. Prepárate, humano.
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#377.src: Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: Prepararse, humano. Arrai-Veretel orco más fuerte. Fuerte en todo. Mente, cuerpo, poder, espíritu.
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: Zuett aún creer humano querer ser bueno. Creer poder acabar guerra estúpida. Hacer entrar en razón a Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#379.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: Derrota a Arrai-Veretel en combate en la arena bajo la sala de reuniones orca.

All Roads to Peace#380.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not repect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#380.dst: Antes de luchar... Deber hacer ritual. Este desafío necesitar respeto. No respetarte, humano, pero mostrar respeto igual.
All Roads to Peace#380.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#381.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: Que la propia tierra nos oiga... Aunque ya no hablemos como antaño...
All Roads to Peace#381.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#382.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#382.dst: Nosotros, humildes moradores de la tierra que ella nos dio, ofrecemos este combate en su honor.
All Roads to Peace#382.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#383.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#383.dst: Que ella quede saciada, crezca sana y nos honre a cambio por esta ofrenda.
All Roads to Peace#383.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#386.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#386.dst: ¡JMH! Humano duro. Vale- ¡Luchar en serio ahora!
All Roads to Peace#386.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#387.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: ¡Por los caídos antes que yo, no perder!
All Roads to Peace#387.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#390.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: ¡No, no! ¡Arrai-Veretel muy herido! ¡¡Humano intentar matar a Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#390.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#391.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#391.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#392.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: Humano ganar. Odiar decirlo, pero humano ganar. Ni intentar matarme.
All Roads to Peace#392.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#393.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: Dar tiempo. Batalla dura- Necesitar calmarse. Esperar en sala de reuniones. Hablar... de condiciones.
All Roads to Peace#393.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#394.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#394.dst: Sentir como insulto parar guerra que no empezar. Pero dar promesa. Humano fuerte. Aún no compensar tanta muerte...
All Roads to Peace#394.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#395.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: Pero humano intentar. Intentar de verdad, de verdad. Admitir, no saber que humano matar tanto al ver... Aun así. Si guerra acabar, muertes también acabar.
All Roads to Peace#395.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#396.src: Hmh. Human probably trying to end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.dst: Jmh. Humano quizá querer acabar guerra desde inicio. Solo en bando equivocado. Estar de acuerdo, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: Dejar de atacar ciudades. ¡Orcos aún defenderse! No enseñar barriga a lanzas. Aún no confiar en aldeanos- solo dar tregua.
All Roads to Peace#397.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#398.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They did not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#398.dst: Dar ocasión para que humano aprender y aldeano mostrar respeto. Si no atacar, estar abiertos a más negociación.
All Roads to Peace#398.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#399.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: Advertir- muchos orcos guardar rencor, en llanuras. Muchos orcos quizá aún atacar. Si así, humano también defenderse. Pero humano evitar lucha allí.
All Roads to Peace#399.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#400.src: ...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: ...si aldeano seguir atacando, defenderse como antes. Humano, asegurar que aldeano saber esto.
All Roads to Peace#400.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#401.src: Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: Ajá. Aldeano más tonto que humano. Aldeano hacer muchas cosas terribles. Pero guerra sin fin no ayudar a arreglar.
All Roads to Peace#401.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#402.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager to stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: Paz primer paso para sanar. ...salvo que aldeano hacer tontería. Entonces quizá luchar igual.
All Roads to Peace#402.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#403.src: So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: Así que Zuett no ingenuo. Algunas cosas... no... poder... perdonarse. Aldeano estar al límite.
All Roads to Peace#403.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#404.src: Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: Humano ver tierra pudrirse en norte. Deber ver, si tomar fuerte en sitio podrido. Bosque antes ser cosa viva. Ahora morir. Muerto en noreste.
All Roads to Peace#404.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#405.src: Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: ¡Empezar solo pocas décadas antes de que aldeano cruzar océano! Aldeano siempre huir de problemas.
All Roads to Peace#405.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#406.src: And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
All Roads to Peace#406.dst: Y aldeano crear propios problemas. Solo significar que aldeano herir tierra, y hacerla morir, lento y seguro. Muchos orcos vivir allí.
All Roads to Peace#406.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#407.src: Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: Incluso cuando aldeano llegar, intentar echar orco, muchos orcos vivir allí... luego tierra empezar a morir. No llegar al sur- ¡y nosotros en sur!
All Roads to Peace#407.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#408.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: Pero... eso desviarse. No más guerra. Dar esto a aldeano que necesitar verlo.
All Roads to Peace#408.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#409.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: Muestra el Acuerdo de Alto el Fuego al capitán Goruca.

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: ¡Humano! ¡Has vuelto! Sí que has tardado. Aunque, bien pensado, no debería sorprenderme. Esos orcos son duros.
All Roads to Peace#410.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#411.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¿¡De verdad lograste que esos brutos firmaran un alto el fuego!? ¡Esperaba que volvieras con un trofeo sangriento, no con una firma!
All Roads to Peace#411.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#412.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#412.dst: Después de atacar con tanta saña nuestro puesto avanzado y de rechazar a nuestros diplomáticos, no me esperaba esto.
All Roads to Peace#412.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#413.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: ¡Aun así, es una buena noticia! Las condiciones son más estrictas de lo que me gustaría, pero mientras nos dejen en paz, cualquier cosa vale.
All Roads to Peace#413.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#414.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: ¿Mmm? ¿Los orcos hablaban de la Decadencia del norte? No sé qué tiene que ver. Nadie sabe qué la causa.
All Roads to Peace#414.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#415.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: Digo, ¿has oído los rumores que llegan de {p}? ¡Dicen que unas brujas maldicen la tierra, ja! Bueno, eso no viene al caso.
All Roads to Peace#415.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#416.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: Toma- tu recompensa. Pensaba darte la máscara para que te colaras disfrazado de uno de ellos, pero... bueno, me olvidé hasta que ya te habías ido.
All Roads to Peace#416.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#417.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#417.dst: ¡Pero SÍ la reforcé con magia hasta convertirla en un equipo potente! Así que te servirá bien. ¡Gracias por tu servicio, humano!
All Roads to Peace#417.speaker: Captain Goruca
